reviews.title: Subscription for a Recipe Book?
reviews.text: All I want is keto recipes. I would pay a cookbook price for that. No chance in hades I’ll pay a subscription fee every month for it.

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text:
There’s no free trial and no lifetime (I hate subscriptions). I can’t even browse the app without paying. 
I think all these recipes were generated by AI. They all have 6 ingredients. I don’t know if they were vetted and taste any good.
Also, the chat assistant doesn’t work.
Most importantly, if I try to save recipes, they are gone the next day. So I wasted an hour browsing recipes. Rip off!
